limitations: Single bounded sequential scan, nonexclusive node; differences around 1-2% are not a demonstrated improvement.

Flat user-cycle perf statistics sample ranks 0 and 4, both sockets. All 34 threads per sampled rank appear. Zero lost samples. Some DWARF call-chain decoding errors occur; leaf symbol statistics are used for quantitative claims.

Sampled CPU-cycle percentages are not wall-time percentages. MPI times are per-rank call wall time including imbalance/waiting; they cannot be summed over ranks or combined with overlapping worker timings as a solve decomposition.
Generic cache-miss counters do not measure DRAM bandwidth or establish bandwidth saturation. Resident NUMA pages are not a measurement of remote-access traffic.
The diagnostic PMPI wrapper instruments Allreduce/Allgather/Waitall/Barrier only inside MPI_Pcontrol(1..0). Normal timing samples are outside that region.
The current finest decomposition is t-slab only; no multi-node claims.
